title: A loop that survives contact with reality
body: Plan, call, observe, repeat — with retries, backoff, and a checkpoint after every step. A run that hits a dead tool at minute nine resumes from minute nine, not from zero.

title: Tools the model cannot misuse
body: Write an ordinary function; Pilot derives the schema from its signature and validates every call against it. Arguments that would not compile never reach your code.

title: State that outlives the process
body: Working memory, scratchpads, and results persist outside the run, so a restart, a deploy, or a week-long pause costs you nothing.

title: Human review, anywhere in the loop
body: Park a run on an approval gate, route it to the right person, and resume exactly where it stopped once they sign off.

title: A trace of every decision
body: Prompts, tool arguments, results, tokens, and cost — recorded per step and replayable against a different model or prompt.

title: Evals that run in CI
body: Turn any recorded run into a test case. Pilot re-runs your suite on every change and shows you exactly which step regressed.

title: Runs anywhere you already deploy
body: A library first — inside your app, a queue worker, a cron, or a container. No sidecar, no broker, no new platform to operate.
